question: Which of the following is true for any $n \times n$ matrix $A$?
explanation:
All three are standard properties of the transpose of a matrix.

$(A^T)^T = A$

$(A+B)^T = A^T + B^T$ for matrices of the same order.

$(kA)^T = kA^T$ for any scalar $k$.

options.B: $(A+B)^T = A^T + B^T$ for any matrices $A, B$ of same order
